items: Acing Development of Innovative Technologies with iDEX
 Drive indigenous defense innovation under "Atmanirbhar Bharat."
 Focus on advanced tech like deep fake detection and cybersecurity.
 Up to ₹25 crores for ADITI Challenge winners.
 ₹10 crores under Defence India Startup Challenge (DISC).
 Eligibility: Startups, MSMEs, and academic institutions.
 Focus Areas: AI, ML, robotics, IoT, quantum tech, and strategic defense tools.
 Mentorship by defense experts and funding via iDEX (Innovations for Defence Excellence).
 Access to testing infrastructure in collaboration with DRDO and armed forces.
